verdict.rationale: Seer Agent lets users ask natural-language questions about their application and finds the relevant telemetry. Sentry's official MCP server lets AI assistants search errors, analyze performance, triage issues and manage projects, which covers natural-language operation through an assistant. missing for 10: documentation that in-product natural-language commands can take actions (not just answer questions), and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask any question about your application and Seer Agent finds the right telemetry to answer it.
Connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading documentation, and managing projects — all via the Model Context Protocol.
